en.headline: Mak apologises to Tai Po fire victims as accountability team member
en.dek: Home and Youth Affairs Secretary Alice Mak said she would follow the Chief Executive’s instructions on reforms and Building Management Ordinance amendments.
body: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said on Saturday that as a member of the accountability team she sincerely apologised to victims of the Tai Po Wang Fuk Court fire and to the wider public.

Mak told reporters after an event that she would follow the Chief Executive’s instructions, stay in post and carry out the large volume of institutional reform and legislative amendment work ahead. She said she would also lead the civil service team to implement the Chief Executive’s directions under a results-oriented approach.

She added that the Home and Youth Affairs Bureau would soon report to the Legislative Council on amendments to the Building Management Ordinance. The bureau had received about 500 consultation submissions, and the independent committee’s report had endorsed the direction of the proposed changes. Mak said the bureau would take account of views from the public and the committee, complete drafting and amendment work, and seek support so the changes could pass promptly and give owners’ corporations clearer guidance.

zh.headline: 麥美娟作為問責團隊一員向宏福苑災民及社會致歉
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長表示會遵從行政長官指示，緊守崗位做好制度改革及《建築物管理條例》修訂工作。
body: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟周六表示，作為特區政府問責團隊的一員，她就大埔宏福苑火災向受影響災民及廣大市民衷心道歉。
麥美娟出席活動後會見傳媒時說，未來會遵從行政長官指示，緊守崗位，處理大量制度改革及法例修訂工作，同時發揮領導作用，帶領公務員團隊落實行政長官的指示，貫徹以結果為目標的施政理念。
她透露，民青局很快會向立法會報告《建築物管理條例》的修訂工作。當局早前已就修例展開公眾諮詢，收到約500份意見，獨立委員會報告亦認同局方提出的修訂方向。麥美娟表示會聽取社會各界及獨立委員會的意見建議，做好修例、草擬及修訂工作，希望取得社會及立法會支持，讓法例盡快通過，為法團日後運作提供更清晰指引。
